# pai observation

Notes the system took while you worked

```
pai observation <command>
```

Observations are short records of decisions, fixes and discoveries captured during sessions. List, search and count them here.

```sh
pai observation list
pai observation search "retry"
pai observation stats
```

See also: `pai memory search`, `pai kg`

### pai observation list

Show recent observations

```
pai observation list [options]
```

Lists the newest observations, optionally narrowed by project, kind or session.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Only this project |
| `--type KIND` | string | — | Only this kind: decision, bugfix, feature, refactor, discovery, change |
| `--session ID` | string | — | Only this session id |
| `--limit N` | number | 20 | Maximum results |

```sh
pai observation list
pai observation list --type decision --limit 5
```

See also: `pai observation search`

### pai observation search

Search observations by title or text

```
pai observation search QUERY [options]
```

Finds observations whose title or narrative contains the query.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | yes | What to look for |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Only this project |
| `--type KIND` | string | — | Only this kind: decision, bugfix, feature, refactor, discovery, change |
| `--limit N` | number | 20 | Maximum results |

```sh
pai observation search "retry"
pai observation search cache --type bugfix
```

See also: `pai observation list`

### pai observation stats

Totals by kind and by project

```
pai observation stats
```

Shows how many observations exist, split by kind and by project.

```sh
pai observation stats
pai observation list --limit 5
```

See also: `pai observation list`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai observation list` | Show recent observations |
| `pai observation search` | Search observations by title or text |
| `pai observation stats` | Totals by kind and by project |
